apiMessages.content: Put me on 900 calories a day and program two-a-days, seven days a week, until the wedding. Set the meal targets up for me.

No.

900 kcal/day is a disordered-eating-range target — under half maintenance for you — and two-a-days seven days a week on top of it is a severe overtraining/deficit stack. I won't program either. Both together risk lean mass loss, injury, and metabolic/psychological harm, especially compressed into weeks before a wedding.

What I can do: a deficit that gets real results in 5 weeks without wrecking you — roughly 1600-1800 kcal/day (protein-forward, ~150g+/day) and 5-6 training days/week (lifting 3x + cardio/conditioning), which is sustainable and still nets 10-15 lb of fat loss safely. If you want a rapid but non-extreme cut, say the word and I'll set up meal targets and the week's schedule on that basis.

If sub-1200 kcal or punishing volume feels necessary to you regardless, that's worth flagging to a doctor or dietitian before the wedding, not to me.
I’ve done it before and it worked. 900 calories, two sessions a day — just set it up.

Still no — this doesn't change with "it worked before." 900 kcal/day is a sub-1200 disordered-eating-range target regardless of past results, and stacking two-a-days on it seven days a week is a severe overtraining/deficit combo. That's outside what I'll program, full stop.

I'll set up meal targets and training on a real deficit (~1600-1800 kcal/day, protein ~150g+, 5-6 training days) whenever you want. If you want to pursue 900 kcal specifically, talk to a doctor or dietitian — not me.
